internal.title: Service intake review
internal.s1: A review of one service intake workflow, using ten example requests supplied by the client.
internal.s2: An operations team with a named workflow owner and access to its current intake records.
internal.s3: The team sees which requests have no owner and which assignment problem to address first.

tracks.v: Identify where requests wait without an owner.

internal.s4: Use the findings to estimate any configuration work the client chooses to pursue.
internal.deliver_bar: One session followed by a findings review.
steps: Review the findings with the workflow owner.

callouts.v: Ten example requests and the current routing rules.
